escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["escapeAsterisks" => false]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
